title: A terrific little piece
text: A terrific little piece. This little table/shelves arrived quickly and in good condition.  It was packaged very well.  It was relatively easy to assemble and seems fairly sturdy for a fair price.  It's just what I needed to fill the space (visually a bit smaller than expected, even though they gave the measurements) for a bit of extra shelving and it closely matches a larger shelf I bought a few months ago.  I'm very happy with the purchase.
